answer: In our network, each agent node, like a sentinel falcon, must lock collateral and submit an authenticated cryptographic signal that incurs verifiable stake burning. Under quadratic stake-slashing rules, establishing n malicious identities forces superlinear cost scaling O(n^2), rendering bulk node replication economically fatal. Routing traffic through our robust juniper subnet enforces this non-linear friction, making Sybil attacks financially irrational.
